title: Reliability Healthbook: rolling initiative snapshots, confidence scoring, and escalation recipes
creator: Ava Patel
description: We need a lightweight, repeatable 'Healthbook' that surfaces per-initiative rolling snapshots (7/14/30d), a confidence score for meeting SLI targets, and clear escalation recipes when error budgets are at risk. This ticket covers the PM-side definition, acceptance criteria, stakeholder alignment, and rollout plan for an MVP that will be consumed by the Console and by on-call runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Healthbook UI spec produced and reviewed by Reliability and Console teams (Confluence link in 'links')
Backend snapshot API implemented to return 7/14/30-day SLI burn, current error budget balance, and recent SLI trend summary
Confidence score algorithm defined and implemented (inputs: SLI burn rate, deployment cadence, recent incidents, traffic volatility)
Escalation recipes authored for: low confidence (<40%), medium confidence (40-70%) approaching error-budget depletion, and automatic temporary throttling guidance
Rollout includes feature flag gating, telemetry to verify Healthbook usage, and a 2-week pilot with two platform teams
Documentation pages and on-call playbook snippets published; stakeholders sign off
comments: 2025-02-12 - Ava Patel: Kickoff with Reliability, Console, and Observability. Agreed MVP scope: snapshots + score + one escalation flow. Will defer advanced reallocation logic to follow-up.

2025-02-20 - Liam Chen: Spoke with Eng; backend snapshot endpoints scoped. Need a small DB store for computed snapshots (timeseries rollups). ENG prefers pre-compute on a 1h cadence to avoid overload on real-time metrics queries.
2025-02-25 - Maya Rodriguez (Reliability): Suggested adding deployment cadence as a weight in the confidence score; will provide historical deploy metrics dashboard link.
2025-03-01 - Design review: initial mockups reviewed. Feedback: make confidence score visual distinct from raw SLI numbers; add human-readable 'next action' card to the UI.

2025-03-03 - Liam Chen: Prototype API PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821. Includes snapshot schema and confidence_score field. Perf test shows 120ms median for snapshot endpoint under 200 RPS.
2025-03-04 - Ava Patel: Updated acceptance criteria to require pilot with two teams: Payments and Search. Filed pilot onboarding checklist in Confluence.
